block: _trim_to_service#pulled back to the last house served
finding: The claim cites 0246's drawing page as a finding for "4 ft at a time", but §6 gives no step size. The 4 ft walk is either a plumbing step that should not be in the claim, or a figure the page does not record.

The claim cites 0246's drawing page for "cut at the house's closest approach", but no block of that page says it. §6 says only "pulled back to the last house it serves", and the 60 ft reach would count an end 45 ft past the house as served. The rule is the GM's ruling of 2026-09-27, so the claim should probably be CANON, or the page should record the rule.
The page does not record the closest-approach cut (no end runs on past the house it serves), nor the exception that keeps a short way between the same houses whole. The code does both.
